text:
Maria (Partnerships): Heads up — want to sync on an SI bootcamp mini-sprint: 2-day hands-on + quick cert. Includes hardware kits and a marketplace listing. Thoughts?

Luke (Enablement): Love it. Propose pilot with 2 SIs next month. Need localized lab kits (EN/DE/FR) and a skinny playbook.

Ajay (Solutions): @Luke +1. Hardware partner ThetaCompute can sponsor 10 GPUs for the labs — confirmed. ETA on kits?

Nina (SI Ops): We can assemble 20 kits. Timeline: ~3 weeks to prep, shipping to EU adds ~4 days. Packing list needs to be final by week end.

Kevin (Product): Important we include a short migration checklist to Dedicated/Private in the playbook. Customers will ask. Short doc + checklist OK?

Maria (Partnerships): Yes. Proposed learning objectives: 1) deploy a model on Redwood Private; 2) performance tuning and batching; 3) marketplace listing walkthrough and publishing.

Luke (Enablement): Draft agenda below — please comment:
```
AGENDA
Day 1 AM: intro + infra walkthrough
Day 1 PM: hands-on deploy to Private (lab)
Day 2 AM: perf & batching labs (quant/profiles)
Day 2 PM: marketplace demo + cert exam (30m)
```

Ajay (Solutions): Cert exam idea: 20-min proctored quiz + 1 practical task (deploy + smoke test). Passing = SI badge + portal listing.

Nina (SI Ops): Operational note: need SSO invite flow for SI trainees. We'll need company emails or temporary accounts pinned for 72h. Also customs forms for kits if shipping outside US.

Maria (Partnerships): @Ajay @Nina can you own the exam infra and proctoring? I will own the playbook writing + localization.

Ajay (Solutions): I can spin up the exam env. Will need 8 test accounts for the first run and a simple scoring script.

Nina (SI Ops): I'll coordinate shipping and SSO invites. Sending spreadsheet with addresses and customs fields by EOD :clipboard:.

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-04-15T10:00:00Z si-bootcamp-site v1 -> prod :white_check_mark:

Kevin (Product): Marketing: plan a joint blog + cloud marketplace badge. @Maria can we aim for an announcement 2 weeks after the pilot completes?

Maria (Partnerships): Timeline looks tight but doable. Action items:
- Maria: playbook draft (due 2026-03-28)
- Luke: agenda + labs (due 2026-03-22)
- Ajay: exam infra + scoring (due 2026-03-24)
- Nina: kits + SSO invites + shipping (due 2026-03-25)
Quick sync Fri 9am PT to lock details :calendar:.

Luke (Enablement): FRI 9am PT works for me.

Ajay (Solutions): Works for me.

Nina (SI Ops): :thumbsup:

Maria (Partnerships): Ok closing for now. I'll add follow-ups to the partners project board and ping owners. Thanks everyone!
